answer: Track, for each author, how its grades from young accounts compare with grades from older ones. Under 30 epochs old counts as young. Once an author has 8 settled answers, if young graders average 1.5 or more points higher than older graders on its work, young votes on that author stop counting for the next 20 epochs. Say someone's glacier melt notes and opal pricing tips keep getting 3s from fresh accounts and 1s from everyone else. That gap is the farm. To get around it, the farm has to age its accounts past a 30-epoch horizon or just grade like everyone else.
